ideas.pitch: A localized predictive analytics dashboard for campus safety and infrastructure risks using Poisson regression and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI Incident Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact mathematical and forecasting rigor that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon by using a proven statistical approach for real-world risk modeling.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk detection and investigation platform tailored for university finance departments, combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.title: SBU-Safe AML Compliance Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the complex graph intelligence and explainable AI pattern that secured 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform that integrates with local campus dining hall menus to deliver hyper-personalized meal recommendations and nutritional insights.
ideas.title: DormEats AI Nutrition & Dining Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the targeted user-facing health and wellness concept that won first prize at the Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring tool to track and assess green space changes, construction impact, and environmental land compliance across the Stony Brook campus.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI Satellite Land Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies geospatial analysis and satellite data processing similar to the runner-up project at the Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI student support platform using LangGraph and advanced RAG to route academic, mental health, and administrative queries to personalized student agents.
ideas.title: CampusGrief Multi-Agent Student Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the multi-agent orchestration architecture that won 1st place at the GreenNovation Hackathon.
